In addition, we investigate the effect of noise on the efficiency of SGD in optimizing strongly convex functions with Lipschitz gradients, and we find that SGD can achieve a convergence rate of $O(1/\sqrt{k})$ under these conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach yields more accurate results compared to training the model directly on the original dataset.

This paper investigates the effectiveness of MCMC estimators in scenarios where the underlying Markov process has polynomial decay rates for its Markov chain coefficients. Specifically, it is found that under polynomial decay rates, the MCMC estimator exhibits analogous convergence rates to bulk data estimators. In contrast, MCMC estimators exhibit the same rate of convergence as bulk data estimators under exponential decay rates.

A matching is considered geometrically convex if connecting any two matched points does not intersect with the bounding box of any other matched point.
